newsitem.title: POLAND: POLL-POLISH REVREPO RATE SEEN DOWN BY END-97.
newsitem.headline: POLL-POLISH REVREPO RATE SEEN DOWN BY END-97.

text.p: Banks expect the central bank's 14-day repo and reverse repo rates to ease by year-end with most players predicting reverse repos rather than repos, a Reuters poll of Poland's 27 biggest banks showed on Monday.
Only four of the polled banks quoted expected central bank repo rates for August, year-end and 12-months ahead.

The central bank last set the 14-day reverse-repo rate at 23.00 percent, but has since raised its main rates by two and 2.5 points and the new reverse repo rate is also expected to be higher. The bank has not staged any repos since early 1995. @
NOTE: In brackets previous figures for end-97 and July-98 from last month's poll.
